name: A multi-category policy groups its paths into distinct semantic lanes (IAM-401)
note: This policy exercises all four primary attack-path lanes at once so the graph must group them instead of laying every node out as a competing radial spoke. iam:PassRole (scoped to lambda) + lambda:CreateFunction is a PRIVILEGE ESCALATION path that must read through the passable-role [unknown privileges] pivot to the lambda service execution. sts:AssumeRole on * is an IDENTITY EXPANSION capability (can-assume role:*). secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on * and kms:Decrypt on * are DATA ACCESS capabilities (can-read sensitive data + a distinct can-decrypt edge). ec2:CreateTags on Resource:* is a standalone broad-resource SCOPE grant (can-write resource:*). Each edge carries its lane; the renderer draws one labeled section per non-empty lane. The findings table remains the authoritative equivalent; the graph is a progressive-enhancement aid.
